actions.headline: Matrimony.Com Limited reports mixed FY26 results with a significant decline in annual profit to INR 34.17 Crores despite quarterly growth, recommends Rs. 5 final dividend.

Tube Investments of India (TIINDIA) announced Q4 & FY26 standalone results, recommended a final dividend of Rs. 1.50/share (total FY26 dividend Rs. 3.50/share), and approved long-term borrowing of up to Rs. 350 Cr.

Board meeting held; 40th AGM on Aug 17, 2026; Record date for final dividend Aug 10, 2026; Mrs. Shanthi Thomas resigned as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director; Mr. Siddharth Thomas appointed as Additional Non-Executive Non-Independent Director.
Board approves Q4 & FY26 results, recommends INR 2 final dividend, and re-appoints Whole Time Director.
Mangalam Cement reports strong FY26 net profit driven by deferred tax reversal, recommends Rs 1.50 dividend, and announces significant capex.
Board recommends final dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share and approves audited financial results.
Bombay Oxygen Investments Ltd announces 65th AGM and provides web-link for Annual Report 2025-26 to shareholders without registered email addresses
